arm.name: w2-think-drop
arm.description: Honest baseline plus an extension that removes thinking blocks from all but the last 2 assistant messages in each outgoing request.
arm.worker_description: Bonsai 2 27B (Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B, 2-bit), a local model on this machine's GPU

sources.model: Historical operative snapshot c9c86b7338aa23ddcf0edd58493e1954d7eb7179:autopilot/config.json (SHA-256 27c9e40f7e845059626304f8f19b22f4cb341ef92d24964b05db972881bd3334) sets roles.worker.model to bonsai-agent; replay registers that historical ID as garden/bonsai-agent, as autopilot.py worker_agent_dir() does.
sources.worker_description: autopilot.py worker_desc() for provider garden; the historical role model is c9c86b7338aa23ddcf0edd58493e1954d7eb7179:autopilot/config.json.
sources.thinking: Historical operative snapshot c9c86b7338aa23ddcf0edd58493e1954d7eb7179:autopilot/config.json (SHA-256 27c9e40f7e845059626304f8f19b22f4cb341ef92d24964b05db972881bd3334) sets roles.worker.thinking to low.
sources.compaction_reserve_tokens: autopilot.py worker_agent_dir(): settings compaction.reserveTokens 28672 for provider garden; this is the historical garden worker harness setting.
sources.session_timeout_min: Historical c9c86b7338aa23ddcf0edd58493e1954d7eb7179:autopilot/config.json has worker_timeout_min 45; intentionally changed to 20 by the W1 milestone.
sources.worker_memory: Historical c9c86b7338aa23ddcf0edd58493e1954d7eb7179:autopilot/config.json has worker_memory null; retained disabled because memory is W3.
sources.prompt_timeout_min: bonsai-2026-10-12-honest: the arm enforces 20 minutes, so the replayed prompt says 20 (W2 candidate 0).

arm.hypothesis: Mechanism: pi resends every earlier turn's thinking (thinking is ~33% of the prompt at compaction/overflow points; 643 of 654 discriminating pairs fit 'resent'), so prompts grow with tokens generated. Dropping it frees context: expect fewer compactions and context overflows, a higher valid rate and kind-match rate, and a lower median wall time, partly offset by re-prefilling the last ~2 turns when the prompt cache misses (compare sum of prompt_ms). Failure counts expected to drop: compaction_start, context_overflow, and timeouts near a compaction (10 of 17 in W1).

turnstile_routing:
models:
  bonsai-2-27b: { slots: 2, ctxPool: 98304 }
virtual:
  bonsai-agent:
    backend: bonsai-2-27b
    maxCtx: 81920
    inject: { id_slot: 0 }
  bonsai-mem:
    backend: bonsai-2-27b
    maxCtx: 32768         # mem0 3.x extraction prompts estimate at ~11k tokens alone
    defaultMaxTokens: 1024
    inject:
      id_slot: 1
      chat_template_kwargs: { enable_thinking: false }
      temperature: 0.2      # mem0 sends no sampling params; JSON extraction wants low temp
      max_tokens: 2048      # nor a cap; this also sets its context budget
route: sandbox tap -> turnstile agent role (bench key) -> bonsai-agent; sandbox network none
